e.title_en: US state insurance-AI regulatory posture MCP (51 jurisdictions, 25 states adopted the NAIC model bulletin, each with citations)
e.title_hk: 美國各州保險 AI 監管態勢 MCP（51 轄區、25 州已採納 NAIC 範本公告、逐條帶引文）
e.summary: 已实测调用：51 个辖区的 AI 监管态势（25 已采纳/4 自建框架/22 未采纳），字段标注 primary/secondary 置信度并附法条引文
e.summary_en: Called live: AI regulatory posture for 51 jurisdictions (25 adopted / 4 own framework / 22 not adopted), with primary/secondary field confidence and statutory citations
e.summary_hk: 已實測調用：51 個轄區的 AI 監管態勢（25 已採納/4 自建框架/22 未採納），欄位標註 primary/secondary 置信度並附法條引文
e.body:
这条 MCP 服务（官方 registry 条目 `com.brelsfordsoftware.agentweb/insurance-ai-regulation`，**v0.1.0 于 2026-08-20 发布、v0.2.0 于 2026-08-21 更新**，status active，端点 `https://agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com/mcp`）回答一个**在保险 AI 治理里天天被问到、却很少有人给出逐条出处的问题**：**美国各州对保险公司使用 AI 到底管到什么程度？** 它自述为「**Cited US insurance AI regulation by state: NAIC bulletin adoption, frameworks, dates**」。

**本次做了真实调用（不是只看描述）**：该端点握手需要带 `MCP-Protocol-Version` 头（不带时实测返回 405 / 406，**这一点已写入词条**），带上后正常返回；`tools/list` 给出 **3 个工具**：**`lookup_jurisdiction`**（查单个辖区的保险 AI 监管态势：是否采纳 NAIC 范本公告、是否自建框架…）、**`list_jurisdictions`**（按态势列表，如 `posture: adopted_model_bulletin`）、**`dataset_provenance`**（返回**数据来源、截止日期、覆盖计数与逐字段置信度**——工具描述明确要求「**在依赖任何答案之前先调用它**」）。**实际调用结果如下（可复核）**：`dataset_provenance` 返回数据集 `us-insurance-ai-regulation/jurisdictions`、`schema_version 0.3.0`、**计数 adopted_model_bulletin 25 / own_framework 4 / no_model_bulletin 22 / total 51**，并给出字段置信度定义——**posture / citation / action_date 均为 `primary`**；`primary` 定义为「**已对照发布机构自己的记录核实**」，`secondary` 为「**来自报道、在用于合规决定前需再用一手来源确认**」；特别值得注意的是 **`quote` 字段的定义**：「**取自已签署法案或单行法的逐字有效条文，仅在确实取回并阅读了来源文本时存在——带引文的记录无需离开本条即可对照法条核查**」。`list_jurisdictions(posture=adopted_model_bulletin)` 返回 **25 个辖区**，逐条带法条引文与日期，例如 **Alaska 公告 B 24-01（2024-02-01）、New Hampshire Docket #INS 24-011-AB（2024-02-20）、Nevada Bulletin 24-001（2024-02-23）、Connecticut Bulletin No. MC-25（2024-02-26）**、Vermont 等。

对 RIAA：**这是「保险 AI 监管」这条线上第一份可以逐条回源、并且把「可信度」写进数据结构的条目**。池内已有 [[naic-ai-oversight]]（NAIC 层面的 AI 监管动向）与一批辖区级条目（[[irdai-ai-governance]] 印度、[[australia-ai6-governance]]、[[korea-ai-accountability]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]] 加拿大、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 欧盟），但**「美国 51 个辖区里到底哪 25 个采纳了 NAIC 范本公告、分别在哪一天、依据哪份公告」这一层此前没有**。更值得学的是它的**数据设计**：**①** `dataset_provenance` 把「来源、截止日、覆盖计数、逐字段置信度」做成**必须先调用的工具**，等于**把「先问数据是哪来的」写进了接口协议**；**②** `primary` / `secondary` 的区分与**逐字引文**（`quote`）把「**能不能不回原文就核查**」变成字段级的承诺——这与本 wiki 自己的核实纪律、以及上一轮收录的 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]（每条带 `source` + `source_quote`）是**同一种做法**，两例放在一起，正好构成「**监管数据应该长什么样**」的两个可对照样本；**③** 对做合规、模型治理或 AI 审计方向作业与论文的学生，「**辖区态势 → 引文 → 日期**」这条链可以直接引用，而不必自己逐州翻公告。相关条目：[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[frai]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]、[[risk-radar-2026]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]、[[openfisca]]、[[psl-tax-calculator]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** registry 条目**未列出代码仓库**，端点站点 `agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com`（HTTP 200，8.2KB）与厂商站 `brelsfordsoftware.com`（HTTP 200，38KB）均在，但**代码不可审阅**，实现方式无从判断；**②** 发布方为**小型软件公司**，非监管机构或行业协会；**③** 版本 **v0.x**，字段中 `verbatim_vs_modified`（逐字采纳还是修改后采纳）在部分记录上标为 **secondary-unverified**，即**这一项本身尚未全部一手核实**；**④** 数据集有**截止日期**，**使用前应按工具自身要求先调 `dataset_provenance` 确认时效**；**⑤** 「51 个辖区」推测为 50 州 + 哥伦比亚特区，但**本次未逐条核对辖区清单**。**核实说明**：官方 registry 条目、端点 `initialize`/`tools/list`、**`dataset_provenance` 与 `list_jurisdictions` 的真实返回**、两处站点均经实测；**未逐条回到各州公告原文比对**（这正是该工具主张自己能省掉的工作）。
e.body_en:
This MCP service (official registry entry `com.brelsfordsoftware.agentweb/insurance-ai-regulation`, **v0.1.0 published 2026-08-20, v0.2.0 updated 2026-08-21**, status active, endpoint `https://agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com/mcp`) answers a question **asked constantly in insurance AI governance and rarely answered with per-record sources**: **how far do US states actually regulate insurers’ use of AI?** It describes itself as "**Cited US insurance AI regulation by state: NAIC bulletin adoption, frameworks, dates**".

**Real calls were made here (not just reading the description)**: the endpoint requires an `MCP-Protocol-Version` header for the handshake (without it the measured response was 405 / 406 — **recorded here**), and responds correctly with it; `tools/list` returns **3 tools**: **`lookup_jurisdiction`** (one jurisdiction’s insurance-AI regulatory posture: whether it adopted the NAIC model bulletin, runs its own framework…), **`list_jurisdictions`** (list by posture, e.g. `posture: adopted_model_bulletin`), and **`dataset_provenance`** (returns the dataset’s source, as-of date, coverage counts and per-field confidence — its description explicitly says to **call it before relying on any answer**). **The actual returns, which can be re-checked**: `dataset_provenance` reported dataset `us-insurance-ai-regulation/jurisdictions`, `schema_version 0.3.0`, with **counts adopted_model_bulletin 25 / own_framework 4 / no_model_bulletin 22 / total 51**, and defined field confidence — **posture, citation and action_date are all `primary`**; `primary` means "**verified against the issuing body’s own record**" and `secondary` means "**from reporting, needing primary confirmation before it is relied on for a compliance decision**". Especially notable is the definition of **`quote`**: "**verbatim operative text from the enrolled or slip law, captured during primary verification. Present only where the source text was actually retrieved and read. A claim with a quote can be checked against the statute without leaving this record.**" `list_jurisdictions(posture=adopted_model_bulletin)` returned **25 jurisdictions**, each with a citation and date — for example **Alaska Bulletin B 24-01 (2024-02-01), New Hampshire Docket #INS 24-011-AB (2024-02-20), Nevada Bulletin 24-001 (2024-02-23), Connecticut Bulletin No. MC-25 (2024-02-26)**, Vermont and others.

For RIAA: **this is the first entry on the insurance-AI-regulation thread that can be traced record by record and that writes "how much to trust this" into the data structure itself.** The corpus already holds [[naic-ai-oversight]] (AI regulatory developments at NAIC level) and a set of jurisdictional entries ([[irdai-ai-governance]] for India, [[australia-ai6-governance]], [[korea-ai-accountability]], [[osfi-ai-risk-controls]] for Canada, [[aae-ai-act-position]] for the EU), but **"which 25 of the 51 US jurisdictions adopted the NAIC model bulletin, on which date, and under which bulletin" had no entry**. More instructive still is its **data design**: **①** `dataset_provenance` turns "source, as-of date, coverage counts, per-field confidence" into **a tool that must be called first** — effectively **writing "ask where the data came from" into the interface protocol**; **②** the `primary`/`secondary` split and the **verbatim `quote`** field make "**can this be checked without going back to the original?**" a field-level promise — the same discipline this wiki applies to itself, and the same one behind last round’s [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]] (every record carrying `source` + `source_quote`). Side by side, the two are **two comparable samples of what regulatory data should look like**. **③** For students writing on compliance, model governance or AI audit, the chain **jurisdictional posture → citation → date** can be cited directly instead of trawling state bulletins. Related: [[naic-ai-oversight]], [[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[insurance-ai-mcp]], [[governance-mcp]], [[frai]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]], [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]], [[risk-radar-2026]], [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]], [[openfisca]], [[psl-tax-calculator]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** the registry entry **lists no code repository**, and while the endpoint site `agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com` (HTTP 200, 8.2KB) and the vendor site `brelsfordsoftware.com` (HTTP 200, 38KB) are both up, **the code cannot be reviewed**, so the implementation is unknown; **②** the publisher is a **small software company**, not a regulator or trade body; **③** it is **v0.x**, and the `verbatim_vs_modified` field (adopted verbatim versus adopted with changes) is marked **secondary-unverified** on some records — i.e. **that particular item is not yet fully verified against primary sources**; **④** the dataset **has an as-of date**, and **per the tool’s own instruction `dataset_provenance` should be called first to confirm freshness**; **⑤** "51 jurisdictions" presumably means 50 states plus DC, but **the jurisdiction list was not checked line by line here**. **Verification note**: the official registry entry, the endpoint’s `initialize`/`tools/list`, **the real returns of `dataset_provenance` and `list_jurisdictions`**, and both sites were measured; **no individual state bulletin was traced back for comparison** (which is precisely the work this tool claims to save).
e.body_hk:
這條 MCP 服務（官方 registry 條目 `com.brelsfordsoftware.agentweb/insurance-ai-regulation`，**v0.1.0 於 2026-08-20 發布、v0.2.0 於 2026-08-21 更新**，status active，端點 `https://agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com/mcp`）回答一個**保險 AI 治理裡天天被問到、卻很少給出逐條出處的問題**：**美國各州對保險公司使用 AI 到底管到什麼程度？** 自述為「**Cited US insurance AI regulation by state: NAIC bulletin adoption, frameworks, dates**」。

**本次做了真實調用**：握手需帶 `MCP-Protocol-Version` 頭（不帶時實測返回 405 / 406，**已寫入詞條**）；`tools/list` 給出 **3 個工具**：**`lookup_jurisdiction`**、**`list_jurisdictions`**（按態勢列表）、**`dataset_provenance`**（返回**數據來源、截止日期、覆蓋計數與逐欄位置信度**，並要求「**在依賴任何答案之前先調用它**」）。**實際返回（可複核）**：`dataset_provenance` 返回數據集 `us-insurance-ai-regulation/jurisdictions`、`schema_version 0.3.0`、**計數 adopted_model_bulletin 25 / own_framework 4 / no_model_bulletin 22 / total 51**；**posture / citation / action_date 均標為 `primary`**（定義為「**已對照發布機構自己的記錄核實**」），`secondary` 為「**來自報道、用於合規決定前需再用一手來源確認**」；**`quote` 欄位定義**：「**取自已簽署法案或單行法的逐字有效條文，僅在確實取回並閱讀來源文本時存在——帶引文的記錄無需離開本條即可對照法條核查**」。`list_jurisdictions(posture=adopted_model_bulletin)` 返回 **25 個轄區**，逐條帶引文與日期，例如 **Alaska 公告 B 24-01（2024-02-01）、New Hampshire Docket #INS 24-011-AB（2024-02-20）、Nevada Bulletin 24-001（2024-02-23）、Connecticut Bulletin No. MC-25（2024-02-26）**。

對 RIAA：**這是「保險 AI 監管」線上第一份可逐條回源、並把「可信度」寫進數據結構的條目**。池內已有 [[naic-ai-oversight]] 與一批轄區級條目（[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[australia-ai6-governance]]、[[korea-ai-accountability]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]），但**「51 個轄區裡哪 25 個採納了 NAIC 範本公告、分別在哪天、依據哪份公告」此前沒有**。更值得學的是**數據設計**：**①** `dataset_provenance` 把「來源、截止日、覆蓋計數、逐欄位置信度」做成**必須先調用的工具**；**②** `primary`/`secondary` 與**逐字引文**把「能不能不回原文就核查」變成欄位級承諾——與本 wiki 的核實紀律、以及上輪收錄的 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]（每條帶 source + source_quote）**同一種做法**，兩例並列正好是「**監管數據應該長什麼樣**」的兩個可對照樣本。相關：[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[frai]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[risk-radar-2026]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]、[[openfisca]]、[[psl-tax-calculator]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** registry 條目**未列出代碼倉庫**，端點站與廠商站均在（HTTP 200），但**代碼不可審閱**；**②** 發布方為**小型軟件公司**，非監管機構；**③** 版本 **v0.x**，`verbatim_vs_modified` 在部分記錄標為 **secondary-unverified**；**④** 數據集有**截止日期**，**使用前應先調 `dataset_provenance`**；**⑤** 「51 個轄區」推測為 50 州 + 哥倫比亞特區，但**本次未逐條核對**。**核實說明**：registry 條目、`initialize`／`tools/list`、**`dataset_provenance` 與 `list_jurisdictions` 真實返回**、兩處站點均實測；**未逐條回到各州公告原文比對**。
